secured a $317.99M firm-fixed-price contract from the Defense Health Agency to provide system reintegration, software licensing, and hosting services for MHS GENESIS, the military's electronic health record system.
The sole-source bridge contract will run through January 28, 2028, with work performed in Reston, Virginia.
The contract will gradually decrease over its 12-month period as the agency transitions to other contractors while working directly with solution providers.
The contract will be funded by fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds, with Defense Health Agency being the contracting activity.

title: Leidos wins $318M contract for MHS GENESIS transition support
